task.description: Design the ISS-0418 fix: per-test process isolation for the isolated wasm_hang CI subprocess, replacing the reframed-away concurrency-cap approach, plus a correction to ISS-0418's own acceptance criteria.

result.note: Design doc written to lib/letflow/design/iss0418-wasm-hang-test-isolation-fix.md. Scope reframing stated explicitly in section 1: the original operator-configurable-cap AC is already satisfied by the existing InvocationLease (2026-09-05) but doesn't fix the flake (proven by ISS-0418's own post-fix CI data, ~50% unchanged). Recommended AC correction (append-only, per REQ-226 AC4 precedent): annotate the cap criterion as satisfied-for-its-own-purpose-but-not-sufficient, add a new criterion for per-test subprocess isolation verified by N consecutive clean local runs. Per-test isolation mechanism (section 4): LIVE-VERIFIED (not assumed) that mix test <file>:<line> --only wasm_hang does NOT compose -- line-targeting silently discards --only entirely, confirmed via --dry-run transcripts. Design uses file:line alone (already bypasses the default exclude). Enumeration is dynamic: a discovery subprocess runs mix test --only wasm_hang --dry-run, parses the Tests that would be executed block for file/line pairs, then spawns one real subprocess per discovered test via the existing stream_and_capture/2 helper reused unmodified, aggregating into the same report shape. Irreducible pair (plugin_handler_test.exs:485, 2 dispatches in one test body) needs no special-case code since file:line addressing is inherently test-body-atomic -- design mandates a one-line warning comment at the @tag site. Overhead measured live: ~1.7s per subprocess boot, ~5 extra boots ~10s added per green run, judged a clear win against 60-180s timeout recurrences. Confirmed lib/letflow/engine/wasm/invocation_lease.ex left exactly untouched -- no production call site changes. Verification: N=20 consecutive local mix letflow.check.test runs as primary gate. Two open questions named explicitly, not silently resolved. Self-checked: all fenced blocks contain only verified terminal transcripts and @type/@spec declarations, no executable logic.
